scope: Read-only mechanical verification of Step8 receipts, case oracles, source pins, and inference boundaries
verdict: accept with oracle corrections and bounded claims

findings.detail: The source is syntax-qualified, analysis-clean, and emits take(c,["fixed",x]) although x has type text?. The expected E3005 code is not produced; this is the real nullable-array admission mismatch, not a receipt failure.

findings.classification: oracle code mismatch; rejection behavior observed
findings.detail: The source is rejected with E3001 (argument xs expects array of text, found array of text?). Requiring E3005 is over-specific and should not be counted as an additional compiler defect.

The analysis is clean despite the team query and call to app_count(), whose body queries app-scoped AppConfig. Emission reports E6008 for unsupported recurring-trigger lowering; it does not make the missed analysis diagnostic disappear. This demonstrates a checker mismatch, not recurring runtime execution or a permission bypass.

The literal has 38 integer digits followed by .0, making 39 significant coefficient digits under the stated scale-preserving rule. E3001 is therefore consistent with the 38-significant-digit limit; this is not a compiler mismatch.
Analysis accepts the named descriptor and locale call, but emission produces E6008 (no descriptor argument). The paired positional case emits cleanly.
Analysis accepts named template and values, but emission produces E6008 (no descriptor argument). The paired positional case emits cleanly.

integrity.source_projection: Primary and extra case source strings hash to the source_sha256 recorded in their observations. The observer source is retained in probe.rs and does not encode expected outcomes; expectations are separately declared in cases.json and extra-cases.json.
integrity.capture_hashes: All stdout/stderr captures referenced by execution.json, extra-execution.json, and generated-execution.json exist and match their recorded SHA-256 values.
integrity.source_pins: All 18 authority.json pinned source files match the current working-tree bytes and report equality with source_ref. The pinned compiler/specification/test files therefore show no source drift against the audited ref.
integrity.temporary_sources: Case source bytes are retained as strings in cases.json and extra-cases.json and their hashes match observations. Temporary paths in argv and raw observer source metadata are not directly replayable after cleanup; source values and hashes are retained, but this is not a fully hermetic replay bundle.
integrity.catalogs: All 26 extra cases use the installed catalog hash cd984f375e0d6cbcc2bc6aca5ad5ea5b1b3d3ba9cd17b15ab94e4b15e74ced62. Primary cases use that catalog for 43 cases; four named catalog cases use retained controlled copies with changed lower availability/kind. The installed catalog has 59 entries, lower availability implemented, active_member and random_secret availability external, and no planned entries. Controlled catalog outcomes do not establish installed provider availability or deployed runtime behavior.
integrity.focused_suites: The recorded cargo command exits zero. Eight test-result summaries total 440 passed, zero failed, and zero ignored; focused-suites.stdout is captured and its command hash validates. This is a focused compiler suite set, not a complete repository test run.
integrity.graph: Twelve fresh-process graph receipts are retained and the structured diagnostics repeat; this is finite determinism evidence for the sampled call-cycle input, not proof for every graph algorithm or origin type.
integrity.generated_runtime: The generated-format Node command exits zero. Its retained observations scope execution to selected production-emitted pure functions/imports with empty context; it does not qualify activation, server/browser integration, installed application paths, permissions, or the whole runtime.

coverage_limits: The 47 primary and 26 extra vectors are finite semantic samples, not exhaustive compiler or type-system coverage.
Owner observations exercise package-owned value encoders, decoders, and public exports on listed inputs; they do not by themselves prove compiler-to-runtime end-to-end application behavior.

Raw compiler JSON includes temporary source paths. Retained vector source and source hashes permit reconstruction of test inputs, but generated temporary files and the compiled probe executable are gone.

No assertion here establishes full-codebase behavior, host integration, deployed provider availability, authorization correctness, or runtime behavior beyond the specifically retained generated-format command and observations.
